name: Phoenix
description: Constant-product DEX on Stellar testnet (Tranche 2 integration fixture)

functions.name: swap
functions.description: Swap an exact amount of token_in for at least min_out of token_out in a Phoenix pool

functions.name: add_liquidity
functions.description: Deposit token_a and token_b into a Phoenix pool and receive LP tokens

functions.name: remove_liquidity
functions.description: Burn LP tokens and withdraw the underlying token_a and token_b from a Phoenix pool

functions.name: get_reserves
functions.description: Return the current token_a and token_b reserves of the Phoenix pool
